pk.context: 145 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Well absorbed, and exposure is not significantly different fasting or nonfasting. About 99% binds serum protein, and most is excreted in urine as metabolites.
clues.substance: An ester pro-drug with molecular weight 360.83, insoluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA, as 48 mg and 145 mg tablets, dosed once daily.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated in severe renal impairment, active liver disease and gallbladder disease; liver test abnormalities and raised CPK are common reactions.
clues.indication: Adjunct to diet in adults with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia, and for severe hypertriglyceridemia.
clues.mechanism: Activates PPAR alpha, raising lipolysis and clearance of triglyceride-rich particles by activating lipoprotein lipase and reducing apoprotein C-III production.

tell: This ester pro-drug is hydrolysed to fenofibric acid, the active moiety whose exposure the label reports.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: Peak plasma levels of fenofibric acid occur within 6 to 8 hours after administration
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: Fenofibric acid is eliminated with a half-life of 20 hours
